what: hir-def nameres/demand.rs `every_body` (and `walk_bodies` under it) allocates with the number of bodies: `bodies` is a Vec::new() grown by push, `seen` an FxHashSet collected from the roots and grown by insert, the queue extended per body. It is no query, so each call redoes it. blaze-diagnostics test lints::bodies::tests::late_passes_per_crate (the late lint passes over a crate allocate the same at 4 bodies as at 64) fails on it in round 15: 10 allocations at 4 bodies, 19 at 64, the growth all from `every_body` called by lints/bodies.rs `body_owners`. Wanted: size `bodies`, `seen` and the queue once from `crate_body_owners(db, krate).len()` (bodies declared in bodies are few), or make `every_body` a tracked query whose result callers borrow.
